# 4 Ezra Chapter 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 10:8 — Zion's husbandman metaphor

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "so-Zion-her-husbandman-has-changed" | Literal — ager agricolam mutavit |
| LOGOS | "so Zion's husbandman has changed" | Same without hyphens |
| PNEUMA | "Zion has lost her Lord" | Interprets allegorically |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "As a field loses its farmer, so Zion's husbandman has changed" — LOGOS for the main clause, with PNEUMA's introductory simile incorporated for clarity.

---

## 10:12 — Zion espoused to the Most High

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "she-was-espoused-to-the-Most-High before-all-others that-were-ordained-to-dwell-in-her" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "she was espoused to the Most High before all others that were ordained to dwell in her" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "betrothed to the Most High before any other place ever chosen to be inhabited" | Paraphrase clarifies the metaphor |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "She was espoused to the Most High before all others that were ordained to dwell in her" (LOGOS). The technical term "espoused" preserves the betrothal/covenant theology.

---

## 10:19 — Ezra's panic cry

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "my-end-has-now-become-corruption, and-my-prayer-has-become-a-reproach" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "my end has become corruption, and my prayer has become a reproach" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "everything has collapsed — my end has come to nothing and my prayer has become a disgrace" | Adds "everything has collapsed" for emotional context |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "My end has become corruption, and my prayer has become a reproach" (LOGOS). PNEUMA's addition is not in the Latin.

---

## 10:35 — the thirty years = three thousand years

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "there-were-three-thousand-years-in-the-world-in-which-there-was-yet-no-offering-made-in-her" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "there were three thousand years in the world in which there was yet no offering made in her" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the world existed for three thousand years in which no sacrifice was yet offered in her" | "Sacrifice" for "offering" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "There were three thousand years in the world in which no offering was yet made in her" (LOGOS). "Offering" is more precise than "sacrifice" for oblatio.

---

## 10:52 — the city identified

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "The-city-you-see-is-the-beginning-of-our-kingdom" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "This is the city that is the beginning of our kingdom" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "This city is the beginning of our kingdom" | Slightly compressed |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "This is the city that is the beginning of our kingdom" (LOGOS). The identifying clause "that is" is important for connecting vision to interpretation.

---

## Total disagreements: 5
